title: Control Board Communication Fault
shortDescription: Main PCB cannot communicate with the user interface board.
fullDescription:
F01 on Ariston dryers (Whirlpool EMEA platform shared with Hotpoint and Indesit) indicates a communication fault between the main electronic board and the display or an auxiliary controller.

Common causes include loose ribbon cables, corroded connectors, moisture ingress, or a failed PCB. A full power cycle often clears transient communication glitches.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Remove top panel, reseat PCB-to-UI ribbon.

title: Motor Tacho Fault
shortDescription: Motor tachometer signal invalid or missing.
fullDescription: F02 means the control cannot read motor speed feedback. Usually due to a broken drive belt, failed tacho, or worn brushes. The drum will not spin reliably.

fixSteps.title: Check belt
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect and replace drive belt if slack or broken.

whenToCallPro: Motor swap typically needs a pro.

faq.a: Yes — unloaded motor gives invalid tacho.

title: NTC Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Temperature thermistor reading out of range.
fullDescription: F03 is triggered by an NTC thermistor reporting an impossible value. Cycle stops to protect the load. Sensor replacement is inexpensive and straightforward.

fixSteps.title: Access sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear panel to expose NTC.

fixSteps.title: Test/replace
fixSteps.instruction: Measure 10-50 kOhm, swap if out of range.

title: Pressure Switch Fault
shortDescription: Pressure switch stuck or hose blocked.
fullDescription: F04 is raised when the condensate pressure switch reports an invalid state. Check tank and hose before replacing parts.

faq.a: Pressure hose kinks can hold residual pressure.

title: Drain Pump Fault
fullDescription: F05 indicates the condensate pump is blocked by lint or has failed electrically. Clean the sump filter first.

fixSteps.title: Replace pump
fixSteps.instruction: Test continuity ~180 ohms, swap if open.

faq.a: Yes, micro-fibres wrap around the impeller.

title: Door Lock Fault
fullDescription: F06 indicates a failed door switch. Dryer refuses to start until resolved.

title: Heater Fault
fullDescription: F07 shows when the PCB does not see temperature rise within expected time. Usually a burnt heater or tripped TOC.

title: Heater Relay Stuck
shortDescription: Heater relay on PCB welded — safety issue.
fullDescription: F08 indicates the heater relay has welded closed. Unplug immediately — fire risk.

title: Software ROM Error
fullDescription: F09 indicates corrupted firmware on the PCB. Typically needs programmed replacement board.

title: EEPROM Checksum Error
fullDescription: F10 means the EEPROM has failed its integrity check. PCB replacement or service re-initialisation required.

faq.a: Yes — default config must be reloaded.
